ios.desc:
** To clear the screen, just press hard enough on it that it clears. **

Explore the 3D Touch capabilities of your device with this app.

It is a simple drawing app that increases the radius of the circle in response to how much pressure you put on the phone.

Combining that with a generated color profile with a random seed and you'll find yourself creating immersive 3D structures in seconds flat.

It's a fun tool that will allow you to see the precision and range of 3D Touch.

Please note: This is only really useful if you do have a 3D Touch capable device. Your experience will be suboptimal if not.

show_hn.title: Show HN: See exactly how sensitive the 3D Touch gradience is on the iPhone 6s

quotes.text: And although 3D Touch is almost entirely unused by almost everybody as far as I can tell, the actual physical implementation of it is brilliant. I wrote this: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/3d-touch-explorer/id1060346713 to demonstrate it (source code here: https://github.com/benslaney/3D-Touch-Explorer). The amount of granularity and the sensitivity of it - equal all over the screen - is crazy.
